All.name: Academic
All.description:
You are learned in many scholarly matters.
Your proficiency level in three of Arcana, Crafting, History, Nature, Society or a Lore skill increases (max Expert)

All.name: Alert
All.description:
With a watchful eye you are ready for danger
Your proficiency level in perception increases (max Expert). 
Your can choose to roll initiative with your perception score instead of your DEX

All.name: Always The Right Tool
All.description:
You always seem to have the correct tool in your pocket.
Once per day, as a two action activity you may find a small tool, gear, ammunition or material you could have bought earlier in your bags.
You then reveal when you bought the item and pay for them.

All.name: Army Training
All.description:
You have served in one of the armies, and trained with its equipment. 
Become trained Light Armor and two weapon groups depending on the army
Draconic Legions. Polearms and Runeguns
Thezan Armies. Swords and Runeguns.
Spellshield Formations. Shields and Swords
El-Shavrian Armies. Swords and Crossbows
Yirte Militias. Bows and Knives

All.name: Athlete
All.description:
You've trained your body 
Increase the distance you can move without making a check when you take the Leap or High Jump action by 2
Your proficiency level in Athletics or Acrobatics increases (max Expert).

All.name: Battlefield Medic
All.description:
You've trained to practice medicine even in the heat of combat
Your proficiency level in medicine or athletics increases (max Expert). 
You don't take the -2 penalty to the treat wounds and stabilize creature actions in combat

All.name: Calculate The Odds
All.description:
You take a moment to think and calculate your next move.
You learn the Calculate The Odds action
All.unlockedAction:
Calculate The Odds - 1 Action (Mental)
Declare an action that requires a D20 roll. Roll a d20. 
If your next action afterwards is to do that action, use that roll
You may use this a number of times equaling to your INT per day

All.name: Combat Training
All.description:
Your have seen combat or trained in a army.  
Your proficiency level in Fortitude Saves increases (max Trained)
You become trained in one weapon group of your choice.

All.name: Dedicated Student
All.description:
You have put practicing magic as your focus ahead of all else. 
Gain one level 1 [Arcane Feats]

All.name: Defensive Training
All.description:
You've trained your defense.
Your proficiency level in one type of saving throws increases (max Trained). 
You may choose this feat multiple times.

All.name: Duelist
All.description:
You experience has you always ready for combat.
When you roll initiative, you may Strike, Cast a Spell that costs 1 action or Step as a free action.
If you get a critical hit a creature with an attack or spells that only target them, they have -1 penalty on D20 rolls until the start of next turn.

All.name: Encouraging Words
All.description:
You may attempt to shake your allies out of fright.
As an action you can persuasion check against the spell or creature that frightens them, reducing their frightened value by 1 on a success or 2 on a critical success.
Your proficiency level in persuasion increases (max Expert).

All.name: Expert Pilot
All.description:
Your skill in piloting vehicles is well known.
Your proficiency level in Airship Lore, Ship Lore or Land Vehicles Lore increases (max Expert).
You count as two people when it comes to operating a vehicle

All.name: Heavy Armor Training
All.description:
Unlike most mages you have experience in fighting in heavy armor. 
You are trained with heavy armor

All.name: Inspiring Leader
All.description:
You have a way with words and can inspire those around you. 
You can use the Inspire Courage action once per day.
All.unlockedAction:
Inspire Courage  - 1 Action
You give a rousing speech or perform an act that inspires your allies in a 5 tile wide aura 
All allies in the aura gain a +1 bonus to attack rolls and saving throws against fear effects for the duration. 
This bonus increases to +2 at level 10 and +3 at level 15. The aura lasts for one minute or until you are incapacitated.

All.name: Item Thrower
All.description:
The range you can throw items, gadgets and potions increases by 3.
Additionally you may attempt a Sleight of Hand check to bounce thrown items around corners or through small openings.

All.name: Linguist
All.description:
You know how to speak with people and master any language you come across.
Learn two extra languages. 
You have advantage on checks to decipher languages
Your proficiency level in Society or Persuasion increases (max Expert)

All.name: Lore Mastery
All.description:
There is one type of lore that you know better than almost anyone.
Choose one Lore skill to become expert in.
At level 5 you become master in the chosen lore
At level 12 you become legendary in it.

All.name: Marksman
All.description:
You've trained in the art of aiming and shooting. 
You learn the [Aim] Combat Maneuver. 
You don't take a penalty when attacking with runeguns or crossbows while prone.
All.prerequisites: Trained with at least one type of ranged weapons

All.name: Martial Arts Training
All.description:
You know how to fight unarmed, from time spent scrapping or formal martial arts training. 
You become trained with unarmed attacks. 
Your unarmed attacks use a one step larger dice (1d2 -> 1d4 -> 1d6 -> 1d8). 
Your proficiency level in Brawling increases one step (max Expert).

All.name: Martial Gun Arts
All.description:
You've learned to fight in close range with your firearm.
You can use runeguns as melee weapons, dealing 1d4 bludgeoning damage or 1d6 if you are holding them in two hands.
You no longer take a penalty to attacks with bayonets

All.name: Nerves of Steel
All.description:
You let nothing scare you
Your proficiency level in Will saves steel increases (max Trained).
You have advantage on Will saves against Fear effects

All.name: Opportunist
All.description:
Your good at striking enemies when a moment of opportunity appears. 
Your penalty on Opportunity Attacks is -2 less (-1 without agile, 0 with)

All.name: Quick Witted
All.description:
You're good at quickly coming up with comebacks and retorts.
If another creature fails to intimidate or persuade you, you may intimidate or persuade them as a reaction.
Your proficiency level in Intimidation or Persuasion increases (max Expert).

All.name: Quip
All.description:
You've learn to banter and quip in the middle of battle to distract your enemies.
You have the Quip action 
Your proficiency level in Persuasion increases (max Expert).
All.unlockedAction:
Quip - 1 Action (Mental)
Make a Persuasion roll versus a creature Will Save.
If you succeed the target becomes Off-Guard 1 until the end of its next turn as it distracts them.
On a critical success it becomes Off-Guard 2 instead.
Regardless of the roll the target is immune to Quip for an hour

All.name: Skilled
All.description:
You have practiced three skills of your choice, becoming trained in them.
You may choose this feat multiple times.

All.name: Sneaky
All.description:
You can move silently and hide in shadows.
When sneaking you can move at full speed without taking the -5 penalty.
You become trained in the knives weapon group

All.name: Staff Training
All.description:
You have trained with staves, a traditional weapon for mages.
You are trained with the staff weapon group
You can turn wood into a battlestaff or longstaff during a short rest. 
If you have the Shape Metal spell you can use it to create a battlestaff as a three action activity

All.name: Surveyor
All.description:
You have studied maps and the land, learning how to read the terrain. 
You become trained in geography lore. 
Your exploration speed is two steps faster than what it would normally be. You can always find north.

All.name: Survivor
All.description:
You have survived against the elements. 
You gain resistance 3 to one type of elemental damage: fire, cold, electricity, acid or sonic. 
You have a +3 bonus on survival checks to avoid natural hazards and extreme weather.

All.name: Tactical Combatant
All.description:
You can make the best of the heat of combat. 
Learn 2 + your INT simple [Combat Maneuvers]
You may choose this feat multiple times.

All.name: Underhanded Striker
All.description:
You know how to strike opponents when their weakened. 
When you attack an opponent that is off-guard you deal 1d6 more damage. 
Alternatively you may instead reduce the Precision attack penalty against such opponents by 2 (to a minimum of 1)

All.name: Untrained Improvisation
All.description:
You are used to improvising and getting into novel scenarios
You have +1 bonus to all (non lore) skills you are untrained in.

All.name: Weapons Training
All.description:
You have trained in a variety of weapons. 
Become trained in two weapon groups of your choice. 
Instead of picking a weapon group you may pick all Simple Weapons or a single Advanced Weapon
You may choose this feat multiple times

All.name: Will to Live
All.description:
Taking your down is harder than most and you don't stay down.
You may add your PHY or WIL to death saving throws.
When you would be critically hit you may spend a focus point to add your PHY or WIL to your save, potentially reducing it to a normal hit

All.name: You're Next
All.description:
You know the perfect line for when you defeat your foes
When you kill or defeat a foe you may use your reaction to use Intimidate.
Your proficiency level in Intimidation increases (max Expert).

All.name: Aerialist
All.description:
The sky is your calling
When you have a flight or glide speed it increases by 1. 
You have a +2 bonus to any acrobatics or athletics check you make in the air.

All.name: Bob and Weave
All.description:
You've learned how to dodge blows in the thick of it.
Your proficiency level in Reflex saving throws increases (max Trained). 
When you hit a creature with an unarmed strike you gain +1 bonus to saving throws against them until the start of your next turn

All.name: Emergency Aura Block
All.description:
Your experience of dangers allow you shield yourself with your aura before your sometimes even aware of the threat.
Once per hour you may Aura Block as free action

All.name: Like Shooting Fish...
All.description:
You can keep reloading as you deal with your foes
Once per turn, when you kill or knock out a creature your may reload an held weapon as a free action

All.name: Skilled Fencer
All.description:
You've trained in the arts of fencing 
You have +1 bonus when Parrying melee attacks
You learn the Cut Down Projectile and Riposte combat maneuvers.

All.name: Always Ready
All.description:
When you roll initiative and aren't surprised you may add your INT or WIL to your roll.
Your proficiency level in perception or insight increases (max Master).

All.name: Armor Expertize
All.description:
When wearing armor the resistances it grants increases by 1, or 2 if its heavy armor.
Additionally your unarmed attacks when wearing heavy armor with gauntlets deal 1d4 bludgeoning damage.

All.name: Commanding Presence
All.description:
Your proficiency level in Will saves increases (max Expert). 
Allied creatures within 5 tiles have a +1 bonus to their Will saves

All.name: Evasion Expertize
All.description:
Your proficiency level in Reflex saves increases (max Expert). 
When you get a success on a reflex save you may use your reaction to turn it into a critical success

All.name: Expert Brawler
All.description:
Your proficiency level in Brawling increases (max Expert).
Your proficiency level in unarmed attacks increases (max Expert).
You learn 2 combat maneuvers with the Brawling trait

All.name: Fleet
All.description:
You've trained to be faster than most.
You move speed increases by 1

All.name: Magical Master
All.description:
You've focused even more on your magical skills
Gain one level 6 [Arcane Feats]

All.name: Martial Expertize
All.description:
Your martial experience has increased with time. 
Your proficiency level in two weapon groups increases (max Expert). 
You may learn one combat maneuver instead of picking a weapon group.
You may choose this feat multiple times

All.name: Move Together
All.description:
You move together with your companion.
When you stride you may have your golem, soulbond or other familiar stride in the same direction
All.prerequisites: You have a golem, soulbond or other familiar

All.name: Perfect Condition
All.description:
You always keep you body in a healthy state
Increase your health by your PHY
Your proficiency level in Fortitude saving throws increases (max Expert).

All.name: Rolling Landing
All.description:
You can use your reaction to treat falls as they were 3 tiles shorter.
If you don't take fall damage from a fall you can immediately step as free action
Your proficiency level in Acrobatics increases (max Master).

All.name: Spot Weak Point
All.description:
Your knowlegde in medicine allows you to spot weak points on creatures.
You have the spot weak point action
Your proficiency level in medicine increases (max Master).
All.unlockedAction:
Spot Weak Point - 1 Action (Mental)
Make a Medicine check against a creatures Fortitude Save.
On a success you spot a weak spot, that can be attacked by your or your allies to deal extra damage to the creature.
The creature has a +2 bonus when targeting its weak point, but attacks to it deal an extra d6 damage
After dealing 20 damage with this the weak point disappears and the creature becomes immune to Spot Weak Point for the day

All.name: Strike The Unwary
All.description:
Your always taking every opportunity to strike your foes
You can now use Opportunity Attacks on creatures using actions with the Spellcasting or Manipulate Traits

All.name: Titan Grappler
All.description:
You've grappled with bigger monsters.
Your proficiency level in brawling increases (max Master). 
You count as one size bigger when determining penalties and bonuses from grappling

All.name: Battlefield Awareness
All.description:
Your proficiency level in perception increases (max Master). 
While off-guard you reduce the penalty by one

All.name: Defensive Duelist
All.description:
Nothing can get past your guard
Your bonus when parrying melee attacks increases to +2.
When you succeed on a Parry you get a +1 bonus to the next attack until the end of your next turn (Stacks up to 3 times).

All.name: Flash Of Genius
All.description:
Your mind works at a greater speed
Once per turn you may spend a focus point to reduce action cost of an action with the Mental trait by 1.
Your proficiency level in Arcana, Nature, History or a Lore Skill increases (max Master).

All.name: Impactful Strikes
All.description:
Your strikes carry enough weight to impact creatures through armor.
Your melee strikes ignore physical resistances up to half your PHY or your full PHY if you use a two handed weapon

All.name: In The Thick of It
All.description:
You fight the best while in midst of combat
If you start of your turn adjacent to 2 or more enemies, gain a temporary focus point that last until the end of your turn.

All.name: Second Wind
All.description:
You take a breath and let energy return to you.
Once per day you spend an action to lose one level of exhaustion and get back a focus point

All.name: Shield Specialization
All.description:
You know how to use shields to their fullest extent.
While you are holding bucklers you may cast spells as normal with that hand. 
You learn the shield bash combat combat maneuver
You learn the Steady Shield action for tower shield
All.unlockedAction:
Steady Shield - 1 Action
Stick a tower shield you are holding in the ground in from you.
Steadied shields provide greater cover to creatures behind them
You need to spend an action to recover a steadied tower shield.

All.name: Strike Together
All.description:
You attack together with your companion.
When you strike you may have your golem, soulbond or other familiar strike the same target
All.prerequisites: You have a golem, soulbond or other familiar

All.name: Rapid Striker
All.description:
You have trained to rapidly strike targets without error.
You multiple attack penalty is 1 lower per step. (-4 normally, -3 with agile weapons)

All.name: Versatile Wielder
All.description:
You're ready to fight with whatever weapon comes your way.
Your proficiency level with all weapons is Expert

All.name: Weapon Master
All.description:
Your proficiency level in a weapon group increases (max Master).
You learn an advanced combat maneuver
You may choose this feat multiple times

All.name: Aspect Infusion
All.description:
Your connection to an aspect has changed you physically and provided with some elemental abilities.
Gain a bonus depending on the aspect
You require 3 mana per hour

All.name: Instinctive Aura Block
All.description:
Using your aura to shield yourself comes naturally to you after this many battles
Once per turn you may Aura Block as free action

All.name: Master Sprinter
All.description:
You can run even faster
You move speed increases by 1
When you take a move action you move one extra tile if your last action was also move action

All.name: Blade Artist
All.description:
You've learned to do the impossible with your weapon.
You learn one Blade Art Combat Maneuver
You can do one Blade Art per day

All.name: Parrying Master
All.description:
You feel ready to take on the world with a blade your hand.
Your bonus when parrying melee attacks increases to +3.
You can Parry with any melee weapon that does slashing or piercing damage, but you only get the +3 bonus to those with the Parry trait

All.name: Elementalization
All.description:
The connection to your aspect is so strong you now have become partly elemental in nature
Gain a bonus depending on your aspect
You require 10 mana per hour
You learn all the apprentice spells connected to your element
You gain the elemental trait

All.name: Legendary Weapon Master
All.description:
Your proficiency level in a weapon group increases (max Legendary).
You learn an masterwork combat maneuver

All.name: Mythic Champion
All.description:
Your training and experience allows you repeatedly go beyond normal limits
You recharge your Blade Arts after 1 hour.
Additionally the first time each day you are reduced to below half health, you recharge a Blade Arts
